message.content: AdamSmith offers to help with the installation of the curtains. This is evident from the conversation where LiHua expresses interest in setting a time to install the curtains together, and AdamSmith agrees to the suggestion, stating "Sure, I’m free most evenings. Let me know what works for you!" LiHua then proposes a Wednesday at 5 pm, to which AdamSmith responds, "Wednesday at 5 pm sounds perfect. Looking forward to it!"
